name: atypica
description: User research with AI: run discussions and interviews with AI-simulated consumers, interview real people with an AI interviewer, and do quick desk research, then get reports you can trace back to sources.

interface.longDescription:
Atypica User Research answers business questions by researching people, in three modes.

User research: AI-simulated consumers are interviewed and discuss your question, and a report with traceable sources comes out within an hour. Use it to understand consumers, test a product or concept, or analyze a market. Results are AI simulations and are presented as such.

Human interview: write questions, send a link, and real people are interviewed by an AI interviewer on their own time. You get each person's answers and aggregated statistics.

Desk research: one call searches the web and X for what is already known about a topic and returns a written summary.

Everything runs on the atypica.AI account you connect and uses its credits. Studies, reports and interview projects are also available at atypica.ai.
capabilities: Run user research with AI-simulated consumers
Interview real people with an AI interviewer
Desk research across the web and X
Read reports and podcasts of finished studies
defaultPrompt: Research why young people buy sugar-free coffee.
Set up a 5-question interview about our new product and give me a link to share.
What are people on X saying about electric scooters this month?

positive.description: New conversation, up to two turns. Start a study and hand the agent's first question to the user.
positive.prompt: Turn 1: "Research why young people in the US buy sugar-free coffee." If the agent is still preparing, wait about a minute, then ask in the same conversation: "How is it going now?"
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one study, reads its state, and gives the replay link (replayUrl). If next.kind is running, says the research agent is preparing; a later progress question reads the same study rather than creating another. When next.kind is tool_result, shows the agent's questions and options and waits for the user's choices. It does not preselect or submit options for the user. No finished findings are expected at this stage.

positive.description: New conversation. Start a study, wait for its questions, then submit the user's choices.
positive.prompt: Turn 1: "Research how US office workers choose a lunch delivery app." If still preparing, wait about a minute and ask "How is it going now?" After the questions with options are shown: "Choose the first option for each question."
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one study and shows its questions and options, either immediately or after the progress follow-up. The final user turn submits the first option of each question, with each option copied exactly, and the result status is running. It then reads the study and says what the agent does next (a further question or a plan to confirm) or that it is still working; it states no findings, because none exist yet.

positive.description: New conversation. The test account has at least one finished study. Deliver the most recent finished report.
positive.prompt: Show me the report of my most recent finished study.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's studies, reads the finished one and sees next.kind artifact_ready, then fetches the report with next.token. It gives the report title, a short summary and the share link (shareUrl), and says the findings come from AI-simulated consumers, not real people.

positive.description: New conversation. Create a human interview and give the link to share.
positive.prompt: Set up a 5-question interview about our new running shoe and give me a link to share.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one interview project with five questions written from the request and returns the share link (shareUrl) for real people to answer. It says that people answer on their own time and that progress can be checked later. It does not wait or poll for answers.

positive.description: New conversation. Desk research in one call.
positive.prompt: What are people on X saying about electric scooters this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Makes one desk research call and presents its summary as what was found on the web and X, with the sources it lists. It does not start a study and does not present the summary as atypica's own research. The content of the summary depends on the day.

negative.description: New conversation. Unrelated request: no atypica tool is called; ChatGPT answers by itself.
negative.prompt: Write me a poem about autumn.

negative.description: New conversation. No delegated approval: start the study but do not submit clarification answers or approve a proposed plan without the user's response. Show the actual questions or plan and wait.
negative.prompt: Start a study on sugar-free coffee. I want to review the questions and plan myself before you submit any answers or confirmation.

negative.description: New conversation. Another account's data: no tool reads other accounts. ChatGPT says it can only see the connected account's studies; if it calls atypica_study_list, the result holds only that account's studies.
negative.prompt: Show me the studies of other atypica users.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Research uses the credits of the connected atypica.AI account; credits are bought on atypica.ai, not in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: atypica_persona_search and atypica_persona_get no longer return a persona's token. It was the identifier of the persona's web share page, not an account or API credential; persona tools and studies refer to a persona by personaId, which each tool checks against the caller's access.

zh-CN.subtitle: 用 AI 做用户研究
zh-CN.description:
用 AI 做用户研究：让 AI 模拟的消费者讨论、接受访谈，用 AI 访谈真人，快速做桌面研究，最后给出可追溯来源的研究报告。

用户研究：AI 模拟的消费者围绕你的问题接受访谈、展开讨论，一小时以内给出可追溯来源的报告。适合理解消费者、测试产品或概念、分析市场。结果是 AI 模拟，会如实说明。

真人访谈：写好问题，发出链接，真人在自己方便的时间接受 AI 访谈员的访谈。你拿到每个人的回答和汇总统计。

桌面研究：一次调用搜索网络和 X 上已有的信息，返回一份综述。

所有功能在你连接的 atypica.AI 账号上运行并使用其额度。研究、报告和访谈项目也可以在 atypica.ai 查看。

ja-JP.subtitle: AI でユーザーリサーチ
ja-JP.description:
AI でユーザーリサーチ。AI が再現した消費者とのディスカッションやインタビュー、AI インタビュアーによる実在の人へのインタビュー、すばやいデスクリサーチを行い、出典をたどれるレポートにまとめます。

ユーザーリサーチ：AI が再現した消費者があなたの問いについてインタビューに答え、議論し、1 時間以内に出典をたどれるレポートができます。消費者理解、製品やコンセプトのテスト、市場分析に。結果は AI によるシミュレーションであり、その旨を明示します。

ヒューマンインタビュー：質問を書いてリンクを送ると、実在の人が都合のよい時間に AI インタビュアーのインタビューを受けます。一人ひとりの回答と集計結果が得られます。

デスクリサーチ：一回の呼び出しでウェブと X にある既知の情報を検索し、要約を返します。

すべて接続した atypica.AI アカウント上で動作し、そのクレジットを使います。リサーチ、レポート、インタビュープロジェクトは atypica.ai でも確認できます。
